findings.description: Saving a new expense once creates two identical rows in the list and counts the amount twice in the total. One POST to /expenses produced two stored records (reproduced with title 'Dup check', $1.00, meals: two rows, and the total rose by $2.00). The duplicate is visible to viewers too, so the data is corrupted server-side.
repro: Enter title 'Dup check', amount 1.00, category meals, and click 'Save expense' once.
Observe the redirect to /expenses?flash=saved, then two 'Dup check | meals | $1.00' rows and a total that includes both.
Sign in as viewer-bcea and observe the same two rows.

notes: Tested: viewer sign-in and read-only view, totals on the base list and per category filter (all correct), viewer 403 on /expenses/new, /expenses/:id/edit and POST create/delete, editor create and edit flows, 404 for unknown ids. Not tested in depth: performance timing, accessibility, delete flow for duplicate rows, and visual review beyond the screenshots. Test data created during the run: 'QA test item' (edited to $20.00) and 'Dup check' rows (two).

cost.notes: estimate from 25202 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0003-$0.0030
